item: A stopword file under configs/stopwords_extra that nests too deeply, or whose top level is not a mapping, or whose stopwords value is not a list, or that is not valid UTF-8, is skipped when the extractor loads instead of stopping the module from importing
refs: R329; R319; follow-on of #1569 (load_safe_yaml depth guard); PR #1592
summary: extract._load_extra_stopwords_by_language read each configs/stopwords_extra/*.yml with the pure yaml.safe_load inside except (OSError, yaml.YAMLError). The pure loader raises RecursionError at about 500 levels, which that clause did not catch, so a deeply nested file in the directory stopped src.analytics.extract from importing (and with it every index pass); a file whose top level was a list or a scalar failed on .get the same way. It now reads with the shared load_safe_yaml (src/utils/safe_yaml.py, depth guard from #1569), which raises YAMLDepthError, a YAMLError, past 256 levels on libyaml and on RecursionError on the pure path, so the existing clause skips the file and its neighbours still load; a non-mapping top level is skipped, and (found by the Opus read) so is a file whose stopwords value is not a list (stopwords: 42 raised on iteration at import; stopwords: abc became the stopwords a, b and c; a !!set or a mapping, which used to load, is skipped) and a file that is not valid UTF-8 (UnicodeDecodeError is a ValueError, not an OSError). Tests: a 100,000-deep flow file and a 2,000-deep block file (deep enough for the pure path's ~500 limit as well as libyaml's 256, so the premise holds in both install profiles; the suite was also run with the loader forced to the pure class), non-mapping files, non-list stopwords values, a non-UTF-8 file, an empty key staying an empty set, and the shipped files (10 tests); red before (5 of the first 6 fail on the old line). ENGINE STAMP: extract.py is in engine_identity.ENGINE_MODULES, so this edit changes the index-engine stamp (R319, a shipped-defect fix): a same-engine backup from an earlier build can no longer carry derived rows and pays one re-extraction, never a wrong row. Release-notes line goes to release-notes-0.5.1-lines.md (R331).
